sections.heading: College of Architecture Pune vs Sinhgad College of Architecture for B.Arch: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose College of Architecture Pune if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹4 LPA, and an admission route through NATA - Exam, in a private B.Arch setting at Pune.
Choose Sinhgad College of Architecture if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹4 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹1.25 lakh, in a private B.Arch setting at Pune.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
We do not hold a quotable programme total for College of Architecture Pune that clears the fee floor on this page, so do not budget from a raw minimum row.

Our records show ₹1.25 lakh as a tuition figure for Bachelor of Architecture (B. Arch) at Sinhgad College of Architecture. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: College of Architecture Pune's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹7 LPA on Bachelor of Architecture (B. Arch). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

Sinhgad College of Architecture's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹9 LPA on Bachelor of Architecture (B. Arch). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Location and campus

Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, College of Architecture Pune or Sinhgad College of Architecture?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. College of Architecture Pune and Sinhgad College of Architecture differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of B.Arch classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for College of Architecture Pune vs Sinhgad College of Architecture?
faqs.answer: we do not hold a quotable fee for College of Architecture Pune on this page; our records list ₹1.25 lakh for Sinhgad College of Architecture on Bachelor of Architecture (B. Arch). Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for College of Architecture Pune and Sinhgad College of Architecture?
faqs.answer: College of Architecture Pune's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹7 LPA on Bachelor of Architecture (B. Arch). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do College of Architecture Pune and Sinhgad College of Architecture accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list NATA - Exam for College of Architecture Pune, and NATA - Exam for Sinhgad College of Architecture. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Pune, Maharashtra. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
